summary: Marvel's Spider-Man entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Marvel Spider-Man

primary.why: The PC Remastered route has the highest graphics/settings ceiling and includes the modern remaster package rather than the original PS4-only route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows Remastered build; verify DLC/remaster content is installed before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: Verify DLC/remaster install rather than assuming every entitlement is present.

entries.title: Marvel Spider-Man 2
entries.definitive_edition: Marvel's Spider-Man 2 for PC - Digital Deluxe-capable build

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; no emulator required.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows native with very high/ultimate ray tracing settings

primary.version: Marvel's Spider-Man 2 for PC - Digital Deluxe-capable build
primary.why: The Windows release arrived after PS5 and has the highest settings ceiling, including official PC specs up to 4K/60 with very high ray tracing; Digital Deluxe content is available on both PS5 and PC, so PC wins on fidelity without losing documented content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows build from Steam or Epic with current patches, use very high/ultimate ray tracing settings if hardware allows, and install Digital Deluxe content if you want the extra suits, Photo Mode items, and early unlocks.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use the current patched PC build; the Digital Deluxe Edition adds suits, Photo Mode items, skill points, and early unlocks rather than separate story missions.

entries.title: Marvel Spider-Man: Miles Morales
entries.definitive_edition: Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales on Windows

primary.version: Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales on Windows
primary.why: The game shipped on PS4/PS5 and later Windows; PC is the highest-fidelity capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows build with current patch and graphics settings verified.
